description: This file defines the Android activity 'ComplicationSimpleConfigActivity' responsible for configuring complications on a wearable watch face. It provides a list of complications, allows the user to select a provider for each, and handles user interactions to initiate provider selection.

classes.name: ComplicationSimpleConfigActivity
classes.description: An activity that provides a user interface for selecting and configuring complications for a watch face.

classes.name: ConfigurationAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for displaying complication options in a wearable list view.

classes.name: ComplicationItem
classes.description: Data class representing a complication option with associated information like icon, name, and supported types.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the list view and its adapter.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from the provider chooser activity, retrieves selected provider info.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles user clicks on list items to start provider selection for a complication.

methods.name: getComplicationItems
methods.description: Constructs and returns a list of complication items representing available complications.
